newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Kabo/Nasr to pay out 4.00 pound 95/6 yield.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Kabo/Nasr to pay out 4.00 pound 95/6 yield.

text.p: Kabo/Nasr Clothing and Textiles said on Sunday it would pay a 4.00 pound dividend for each of its 3.062 million shares for the financial year 1995/6.
In the previous financial year, the company gave a cash dividend of 2.90 pounds plus a free share for each of the 1.521 million shares then issued.
The firm listed two sets of figures for its after-tax profits in results published in Cairo newspapers.
One set said profits rose to 22.638 million pounds ($6.66 million) from 22.309 million in 1994/95 while the other set said 1995/6 profits rose to 22.761 million from 22.176 million.
Company officials were unavailable to comment on the discrepancy.
Reuters has quoted company sources as saying the firm's net profits were 22.5 million pounds in 1995/96 and 16.08 million pounds in the previous year.
The shares last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange at 65.50 pounds on September 17.
The company said production in 1995/6, which ended on June 30, was worth 162.1 million pounds, 16.8 percent up on a target of 138.8 million. Turnover in 1994/5 was 154.25 million pounds.
